name: Soyuz TMA-10
about: Soyuz TMA-10 (2007-008A), a crewed vehicle (7K-STMA), launched 2007 Apr  7. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).
